FILTER(WHERE cur_tx > 0 AND first_seen < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)) AS existing_active, COALESCE(SUM(prev_tx), 0) AS transactions_previous, COALESCE(SUM(cur_tx), 0) AS transactions_current, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE prev_tx >= 2) AS clients_with_repeat_previous, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE cur_tx >= 2) AS clients_with_repeat_current, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw WHERE client_key IS NULL AND ((tx_day >=
